recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中箭頭所指為核偏心、染色質塊狀、細胞質灰藍並有核旁淡染區的漿細胞，數量散在增加，中央是一顆大型巨核細胞作為對照；在類澱粉沉積症中這些漿細胞代表潛在的克隆性漿細胞群，但抹片本身看不到類澱粉或凝血因子 X 缺乏。
features: Scattered plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clumped chromatin, and grey-blue cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof
Plasma cells are mature-appearing without prominent nucleoli or multinucleation
Large megakaryocyte with lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm in the center
Background of trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
No amorphous extracellular amyloid material evident on this smear
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with a centrally placed megakaryocyte and scattered mature-appearing plasma cells (arrows) with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, and perinuclear hofs. The plasma cells lack prominent nucleoli or atypical forms, and a precise percentage cannot be estimated from a single field. No extracellular amyloid is evident on the smear. In a patient with amyloidosis, these findings support an underlying plasma cell dyscrasia; clonality should be established by kappa/lambda immunohistochemistry or flow cytometry, and acquired factor X deficiency is a laboratory finding that cannot be assessed morphologically.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells look identical, so light chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry is required to distinguish them.
Myeloma usually shows at least 10% clonal plasma cells, often sheets, immature or binucleate forms, and end-organ damage, which cannot be confirmed from this field.
Osteoblasts are larger with a hof separated from the nucleus and occur in clusters, whereas these cells are smaller with a juxtanuclear hof.
